title: crotalaria rubiginosa
intro: Crotalaria rubiginosa, commonly known as Partridge pea or Quaker buttons, is a flowering plant in the legume family. It is native to tropical and subtropical regions and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. Crotalaria rubiginosa is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, treat snake bites, and alleviate rheumatism, thanks to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
